nodes.long_description:
Your movies deserve more than a flat rectangle.

AuraPlay turns the space around you into a personal cinema — a screen as big as you like, floating in your own room, wrapped in light that moves with every frame. It's the ambient magic of a high-end home cinema, built into your headset. No wires, no dark room required.

• Giant virtual screen — place it on your real wall or float it in space. It stays exactly where you put it.
• AuraLight — our signature reactive lighting reads the colour of every scene and casts it onto your real walls and ceiling in real time. Sunsets, explosions, neon streets — your room lives inside the movie. Fully adjustable, or off for a pure blackout cinema.
• Plays your own videos — MP4, MKV and more, with automatic multi-language subtitle detection and support for your own subtitle files.
• True 3D movies — side-by-side and over-under, with comfort controls for easy long sessions.
• Tune everything — brightness, screen size, aura intensity and colour vividness, with one-tap ambience presets.
• Comfortable mixed reality — passthrough keeps you aware of your real room.

No subscriptions. No accounts. No data collected. Just your films, your room, and a cinema that finally feels alive.

Tap "Play Sample" to see it in action instantly.

Sample footage shown in screenshots courtesy of the Blender Foundation (blender.org), licensed under CC-BY.

nodes.change_log:
AuraPlay 1.4.0 — Release Notes

Version: 1.4.0 (build 12) · Store build (Meta Horizon) File: AuraPlay-1.4.0-store-release.apk (~20 MB, signed)

What's New

Curved screen, a whole new look, and a smarter cinema.

Curved Screen mode — wrap the picture around you for a true cinema feel, in both passthrough and the virtual cinema. Toggle it in Settings.
Redesigned Settings panel — cleaner, grouped sections with live value readouts, new icons, and a fresh sidebar.
Room Illumination control — dial how much AuraLight spills onto your real room (passthrough).
Better virtual cinema — stadium-raked seating so the row in front never blocks the screen, smoother wall/curtain lighting, and tidier surroundings.
Simpler screen placement — Distance and Size are now two clean, independent controls that no longer fight each other.
Playback bar — locked neatly under the screen in passthrough; a free-floating, movable bar in the cinema.
Continue Watching — the Home screen remembers your last film and picks up where you left off, even after a restart.
Assorted stability and polish fixes.

Full change list (internal)
Curved (cylinder) screen rendering — isocentric geometry, works in passthrough (in-scene curved mesh) and cinema; toggle persisted.
Settings panel redesign: section-based dynamic layout (Screen / Picture / AuraLight / About), gradient sliders with value readouts, row + nav icons, brand mark, selection accent, mode crumb.

New Room Illumination slider (passthrough-only) bound to the AuraLight room-projection intensity; AuraLight section hidden entirely in the virtual cinema.

Distance/Scale decoupled and simplified to two independent controls (removed the compensation-curve experiments).

Transport bar: screen-locked in passthrough, movable 3D frame in cinema; fixed a seat-teleport bug where tapping the screen picked a seat.

Cinema environment: stadium seating rake, 8-bit banding removed (dither + highp) on seats and room surfaces, promo poster removed.
Corner-control aim fixed (hit-tested on the same plane as the cursor).

Continue Watching persistence across restarts; long filenames now ellipsize inside the card.

Store flavor confirmed clean of USB/camera permissions.

Release: 1.3.1 — stadium-rake cinema floor so seats don't block the screen

Hotfix: people already using the cinema couldn't see the whole screen from
behind the seats. Fixed the sightlines properly (not by shrinking seats):
- Stepped/stadium floor — front 0, middle +0.40, back +0.80 — carpeted risers
  in Blender; recliners + seat-glide raised to match; envDropY -1.70
- Screen raised +0.15m up the front wall so its bottom clears the seat-backs
- Seats kept full-size

Also in this build (Phase 1 quick wins):
- Passthrough brightness now applied at startup from the persisted value
- Larger, sharper transport-bar timecode

What's new

Home Cinema

AuraPlay's first virtual environment

I've spent some time designing a home cinema environment and would love you to try it out. Open the menu, click on Spaces, and select Home Cinema. Point at any seat and pull the trigger to glide into it. You can choose any seat - front row, middle row or back row. The environment lights dim automatically when your film starts and there's a Room Brightness slider in the Spaces tab in settings screen. Passthrough is still the default and you can return to it any time by selecting it again in the Spaces tab. The Spaces are a work in progress and the cinema space is the first one. The furniture and lighting are still evolving and may change on a later update.

Stream from your PC or NAS (DLNA)

No more need to copy films onto the headset. Open the menu, click on source > Select and Play > Network, and pick your media server. Browse your library on the poster wall and play straight over your network.

Open the menu from anywhere.

Press B (right controller) or Y (left) to bring up the settings panel instantly. The settings panel and playback bar now float freely in VR space. Grab the title bar / handle and hold the trigger to move them anywhere you like.

Smarter playback bar.

When a film starts, the controls appear just under the screen, then fade out of your way. Tap the screen at any time to bring them back.

True mute

Tap the speaker icon to mute instantly. unlike turning the volume to zero, the also silences the film in Quest screen recordings, so demo clips won't carry copyrighted movie audio.

Also included (from 1.2, if you're coming from an earlier build)

Accurate controllers

Your real Meta controllers now appear correctly in-headset with the right model for whichever controllers you're holding, and they are properly aligned to your hands.

Correct aspect ratio

Films are no longer stretched to fit. 4:3 shows and cinemascope films now keep their proper aspect ratio. with proper letter boxing.

Continue watching

AuraPlay now remembers where you stopped and picks up right where you left off.

Sharper 3D and cleaner rendering

A depth buffer fix resolved see through geometry and improved all 3D content.

Richer AuraLight and full blackout

More control over the reactive room glow plus a total black void when you want zero ambient light.

Plus a batch of other smaller fixes across both releases. Resume position reliability, long filenames no longer overflowing, and a cleaner splash screen.

What's New

Your real controllers, and a much better picture

AuraPlay now shows your actual Meta controllers while you watch.  Buttons, thumbstick and triggers are all there, lined up exactly with the controllers you're holding. They come from the headset itself, so they always match whatever controllers you're using.

This update also brings:

Films look right - video now keeps its correct shape. 4:3 and cinemascope films are no longer stretched or squashed to fit.
Continue watching - AuraPlay remembers where you got to and picks up where you left off.
Richer AuraLight - the glow on your walls is noticeably more colourful and vivid.
True black void mode - dim the room all the way to full darkness for proper cinema blackout.
Important fix - resolved a freeze that could occur when switching between several videos in a row.
Sharper, more solid 3D throughout the app.

v1.1
• Correct aspect ratio - widescreen and classic 4:3 films now display in their
  true shape instead of being stretched

• Continue watching - films resume where you left off, and your screen stays
  where you put it between sessions

• Full blackout mode - dim your room all the way to black for proper cinema

• Richer, more vivid AuraLight - deeper colours on your walls

• Fixed a bug where the picture could freeze on the logo after switching
  between several videos

Thank you for the feedback everyone. 

More on the way.
Dave
